title: Blixo for Xero Users: How Finance Teams Cut Manual Invoicing in 30 Days
summary: Blixo for Xero Users: How Finance Teams Cut Manual Subscription Billing Key Takeaways Manual invoice processing costs over $3 per invoice once you include errors. 66% of businesses spend more than five days monthly on invoice work. Finance teams with 100 subscriptions spend half their time on billing tasks. Subscription businesses often need dedicated staff at around 500 subscriptions. SaaS companies need billing that scales without adding headcount. Why Manual Invoice Processing in Xero Breaks Down Finance teams hit the same wall: manual invoice processing eats time. For SaaS subscription companies, recurring billing must scale without new hires. Manual workflows stop working once you pass a few dozen subscriptions.
